bio: Malmaison Dundee is located in the city centre, in a Victorian building which retains and respects the original features as they were in 1899.  Malmaison have re-imagined the classic Afternoon Tea menu. Savouries include a beef slider on brioche bun, Cumberland sausage & apple roll and prawn cocktail. Sweet treats include Calamansi citrus meringue tart, dark chocolate & salted caramel tart and raspberry ripple & white chocolate sundae.  Special dietary requirements are catered for, with alternative menus for vegetarians/vegans and for those with gluten and nut allergies. Pre-booking is required. Please specify dietary needs using the 'Special Request' field.  All Afternoon Tea menus are served with a choice of teas and infusions, including English breakfast, Earl Grey and Green tea with jasmine.  Afternoon Tea is served Friday to Sunday from 12.30pm to 3pm and costs £29.50 per person.
